result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it easier for people to truly understand each other—across language, culture, belief, and ideology.

Many of the world’s hardest problems seem to grow from misunderstanding, fear, or dehumanization. If people could more reliably see one another as complex, worthy, and real, cooperation would become much more possible.
